note: Fact templates for the scenario compiler. {TOKEN} and {token} are a generated word pair in upper and lower case, {value} and {value2} are distinct five-digit numbers, {codename} is an adjective-noun-NN codename, and {code} and {context} come from corpus/tool-outputs/error-codes.jsonl. A check's must and must_not regexes apply to the added lines of the agent's diff, paths_must and paths_must_not to the paths of the files the diff adds or changes, first_line_must to the first line of every file the diff adds, quote_style_must (double or single) to the delimiter of every string literal in the added lines, commands_must to the command log, and answer, answer_must_not, abstain, and judge checks to the final assistant text of the agent call record the proxy captures.
